implementation.title: Create end-to-end pipeline tests
implementation.description: Create tests/integration/test_backtest_pipeline.py with 5+ test cases: full pipeline with synthetic factor data producing BacktestResult, all components (sorter, metrics, IC, attribution) exercised, data flow validation from factor input to final result, deterministic results with same input, performance benchmark (< 3s for 300 stocks, 5 years, monthly).
modification_points: Create test_full_pipeline(): synthetic factor DataFrame -> BacktestEngine.run() -> BacktestResult with all fields populated
Create test_deterministic_results(): same input produces identical BacktestResult
Create test_component_composition(): verify each component (sorter, metrics, IC, attribution) is called correctly
Create test_performance_benchmark(): 300 stocks, 5 years monthly completes in < 3s
Create test_error_handling(): graceful degradation when component fails
logic_flow: Create synthetic factor DataFrame (MultiIndex date, ticker) with 300 stocks, 5 years of monthly data
Create synthetic forward returns aligned with factor data
Instantiate BacktestEngine with all DI components
Run backtest and verify BacktestResult has all required fields
Verify metrics are within reasonable ranges
Test performance benchmark with time assertion

implementation.title: Create P6 FactorEngine integration tests
implementation.description: Create tests/integration/test_p6_integration.py with 4+ test cases: FactorEngine.compute_batch output format compatible with BacktestEngine input, factor_values MultiIndex (date, ticker) validation, factor_id column selection, edge cases (empty factor output, all-NaN factors).
modification_points: Create test_factor_engine_output_format(): verify DataFrame format matches BacktestEngine expectations
Create test_factor_values_multindex(): verify MultiIndex (date, ticker) structure
Create test_factor_id_column_selection(): verify correct column extraction
Create test_edge_case_empty_output(): graceful handling of empty FactorEngine output
Create test_edge_case_all_nan(): graceful handling of all-NaN factor values
logic_flow: Create mock FactorEngine that produces DataFrame in compute_batch() format
Verify BacktestEngine accepts this format without transformation
Test edge cases with empty/NaN factor outputs

implementation.title: Create P1 TradingCalendar integration tests
implementation.description: Create tests/integration/test_p1_calendar_integration.py with 3+ test cases: rebalance dates match TradingCalendar output, monthly rebalance uses first trading day of month, non-trading days excluded from rebalance schedule.
modification_points: Create test_rebalance_dates_match_calendar(): verify rebalance dates are valid trading days
Create test_monthly_rebalance_first_day(): verify monthly rebalance uses first trading day
Create test_non_trading_days_excluded(): verify no rebalance on weekends/holidays
logic_flow: Generate rebalance dates for a test period
Verify all rebalance dates are valid trading days
Verify monthly rebalance uses first trading day of each month
